groups.instruction: In each sentence one word has had its letters jumbled and is printed in capitals. Rearrange those letters to make the word the sentence needs. Every letter is used exactly once.
groups.example: The boy kicked the BLAL across the yard. BLAL rearranges to BALL, which is the word the sentence needs.

groups.instruction: In each question, rearrange the capital letters to make one word that matches the clue after the dash. Every letter is used exactly once.
groups.example: EELVNE — a number that comes between ten and twelve. The letters rearrange to ELEVEN.
